nodes.description: Constant mint price 0.06 * 1e18 wei used to validate msg.value in FoxGame.mint

Public view returning the internal minted counter as total supply
Internal view random(uint256 seed) hashing tx.origin, blockhash(block.number-1), block.timestamp and seed

onlyOwner function setting controllers[controller] = true
onlyOwner function setting controllers[controller] = false
